_comment: Hand-kept half of the ticket lifecycle diagram. The columns and their order come from DEFAULT_COLUMNS in plugins/_shared/skills/board-setup/scripts/create_board.py, the card moves each plugin command makes from plugins/*/commands/*.md, and the crew from team.json; lifecycle_diagram.py reads those and warns about anything this file does not describe. Movers are a team.json lead id (captain), a plugin name, or github (a board automation or GitHub itself). CI regenerates docs/crew/lifecycle.drawio on main after each merge; preview with python integrations/crew/lifecycle_diagram.py, but never commit the result on a branch.
title: Ticket lifecycle — from idea to Done

In Definition.meaning: An idea not yet understood well enough to refine.

Backlog.meaning: Refined into a story with user value and testable acceptance criteria, or waiting to be.

while_here.text: /scrum-master:refine: value, criteria, size; items sized 13+ split by the story-splitter

Ready.meaning: Meets the Definition of Ready: testable criteria, a size, and small enough to finish inside one sprint.

while_here.text: /scrum-master:plan-sprint picks the tickets that fit the sprint goal and capacity

In progress.meaning: Being built, or sent back by code review or QA to be fixed.

while_here.text: /qa:plan: test cases for every acceptance criterion, before it is built
UI ticket: /designer:spec before building, /designer:review before pushing

In review.meaning: A PR that closes the ticket is open, waiting for code review.

while_here.text: Repo with PR previews: every push deploys a review link and names its commit on the ticket
/code-reviewer:review: approve moves it on; request changes sends it back

In approval.meaning: Code review approved. The Captain reviews the code personally before QA sees it.

while_here.text: Reviews the PR's code; on approval moves the card to QA

QA.meaning: Approved for testing. QA picks up tickets only from this column.

while_here.text: /qa:verify on the newest review link that serves the PR's head

Ready for Merge.meaning: Passed QA with evidence for every criterion. Waiting for the Captain's merge.

Done.meaning: Merged. GitHub closed the ticket through the PR's Closes #N.

transitions.how: A raw idea; notes:to-tickets files (optional) items here
Refined stories filed with tickets.py batch; /qa:bug files each bug labelled QA testing; notes files TODO items
/scrum-master:refine turns the idea into a story
The developer starts the ticket (crew-workflow: one column at a time, shown to the Captain first)
/developer:ship: branch, PR that closes the ticket, card moved after the PR exists
Request changes: any blocker or major finding
/code-reviewer:review approve: no blocker or major finding
Approve on a ticket labelled skip_approval: skips the Captain's review
Reject: a comment on what fails, a bug ticket per failure
/qa:verify accept: every criterion passed with evidence (adds the column if the board lacks it)
The Captain merges; GitHub closes the ticket and the board moves it
